tools.name: robaws_whoami
tools.description: Show the Robaws user, tenant, permissions and companies that the connected API credentials belong to. Good first call to check the connection. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/whoami.

tools.name: robaws_search_clients
tools.description: Search Robaws clients (customers and leads) by text, e-mail, VAT number or logic id. Returns one page of client records. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/clients.

tools.name: robaws_get_client
tools.description: Get one Robaws client by id, with its address, billing settings and extra fields. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/clients/{id}.

tools.name: robaws_create_client
tools.description: Create a Robaws client, or a lead when status is set to a status configured in Robaws. Creates a new record on every call (not idempotent). Robaws API: POST /api/v2/clients.

tools.name: robaws_search_offers
tools.description: Search Robaws offers (quotations) by text, client or project. Returns one page of offers. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/offers.

tools.name: robaws_get_offer
tools.description: Get one Robaws offer by id, with its lines and totals. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/offers/{id}.

tools.name: robaws_search_work_orders
tools.description: Search Robaws work orders by text, date range, client, project or assigned employee. Returns one page of work orders. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/work-orders.

tools.name: robaws_get_work_order
tools.description: Get one Robaws work order by id, with its time, material and line entries. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/work-orders/{id}.

tools.name: robaws_search_sales_invoices
tools.description: Search Robaws sales invoices by text, date range or client. Returns one page of invoices. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/sales-invoices.

tools.name: robaws_get_sales_invoice
tools.description: Get one Robaws sales invoice by id, with its lines and totals. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/sales-invoices/{id}.

tools.name: robaws_search_projects
tools.description: Search Robaws projects by text, logic id or client. Returns one page of projects. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/projects.

tools.name: robaws_get_project
tools.description: Get one Robaws project by id. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/projects/{id}.

tools.name: robaws_search_articles
tools.description: Search Robaws articles (products and services) by name or article number. Returns one page of articles. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/articles.

tools.name: robaws_get_article
tools.description: Get one Robaws article by id, with its prices and calculation settings. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/articles/{id}.

tools.name: robaws_search_suppliers
tools.description: Search Robaws suppliers by text. Returns one page of suppliers. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/suppliers.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "robaws_whoami" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
